explication: This repository is a Node.js testing-practices guide, with a showcase order-service component and smaller recipes illustrating other frameworks and testing topics. The central example workflow accepts HTTP or queue input, applies order logic, accesses persistence and collaborators, and reports errors. The README documents broader coverage of component tests, infrastructure, data, integrations, queues, and mocking; recipe and anti-pattern branches represent those topics without mapping test/build machinery. Relationships in the showcase follow sampled source; broader topic links are documented by the README.
